task_completion.description: The agent opens the Sugar Write activity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Sugar Write interface (word processor) is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The document contains a 'Learning Objectives' section with at least two objectives.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Learning Objectives' is visible as a heading, followed by at least two distinct bullet points or numbered items.

task_completion.description: The document contains a 'Daily Schedule' section with a 5-column table.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A table is visible under the 'Daily Schedule' heading with 5 columns labeled Monday through Friday and at least 2 rows of content.

task_completion.description: The document contains an 'Assessment' section describing student progress measurement.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Assessment' is visible as a heading followed by descriptive text regarding student progress.

task_completion.description: The document is saved as an ODT file to the specific path /home/ga/Documents/literacy_plan.odt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' or 'Keep' dialog shows the file path /home/ga/Documents/literacy_plan.odt or the file manager shows the file at that location.

task_completion.description: The Sugar Journal entry for the activity is titled 'Literacy Plan Week 3'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The activity title bar at the top of the Write activity or the entry in the Sugar Journal shows the text 'Literacy Plan Week 3'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Write activity GUI rather than just creating a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Write activity menus, toolbars, and table insertion tools.

integrity.description: The agent manually typed or structured the lesson plan content.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the document being built incrementally rather than appearing instantly via a single paste or command.

integrity.description: The agent did not use 'touch' or 'echo' commands in the terminal to bypass the word processor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is not the primary tool used for document creation; the Write activity remains the active window for content generation.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The document must be an ODT file located at /home/ga/Documents/literacy_plan.odt. It must contain three specific headings: 'Learning Objectives', 'Daily Schedule', and 'Assessment'. The 'Daily Schedule' must be a table with 5 columns (Monday-Friday). The Sugar Journal title must be exactly 'Literacy Plan Week 3'.
